taxon_match.method: Exact reviewed APHIS quarantine-program to Project Isitusa catalog mapping

geography_match.method: Exact explicit five-digit APHIS county FIPS plus matching registered active county name; no coordinates or successor inference

temporal_scope: Current APHIS quarantine snapshot; the retained rows expose no usable program date.
spatial_scope: APHIS explicitly assigns Bingham County, Idaho to the named quarantine program. This supports regulatory recorded-present evidence only, not organism abundance or full-county biological distribution.
caveats: Regulatory quarantine geography supports the named program condition, not broader abundance or county inventory.
A quarantine can include buffer, movement-control, or administrative areas and is not a population survey.
Snapshot silence never supports absence or non-detection.
notes: Accepted regulatory statuses: Active Federal Quarantine.
